subject: Pause request: NimbleHealth LLM pilot — shifting roadmap priorities
messages:
From: Claire Ng <claire.ng@nimblehealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.example.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo scheduling — NimbleHealth LLM pilot

Hi Hannah,

Quick update from our side — we just finished a leadership sprint planning session and resources are getting reallocated to a few immediate regulatory initiatives. As a result, the LLM/inference work (including the pilot we discussed) is being deprioritized for the next couple of quarters.

We still value the work we've done with Redwood and want to keep the relationship warm, but we need to pause active demos and technical onboarding for now. Can we put our scheduled demo window on hold and revisit in Q4? If helpful, I attached a one-page snapshot from our product team showing the current roadmap squeeze.

If there are any small clarifying questions, happy to hop on a 20-minute call, otherwise please mark the pilot as paused and I'll reach back out when priorities shift.

Thanks — apologies for the abrupt change.

Claire Ng
Director of Product, NimbleHealth
claire.ng@nimblehealth.com

Attachment: NimbleHealth_Q3_Roadmap_Snapshot.pdf (pdf)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.example.com>
To: Claire Ng <claire.ng@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.example.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo scheduling — NimbleHealth LLM pilot

Thanks for the update, Claire — appreciate the heads up and the attachment.

Totally understand the reprioritization. We'll mark the pilot/demo as paused on our side and move the scheduled demo out of your calendar. Can you confirm whether you'd like us to: 1) fully cancel the demo invite and rebook only when you reach out, or 2) tentatively keep a placeholder and we follow up in mid-September to assess timing?

Internally, Jordan and I will log this as "parked" in HubSpot and add a 90-day nurture reminder. If you prefer a short readout for any stakeholders (executive one-pager or a 10-min async demo recording), we can prepare that and drop it in your drive.

Happy to offer two hours of technical office-hours during your ramp back up if that helps reduce friction at re-engagement. No pressure — whenever you're ready.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.example.com
Redwood Inference — Developer-first inference platform

Thanks for flagging — I'll take the action items:

- I'll update the HubSpot deal NH-2026-0920 status to "Parked — customer reprioritized" and set a 90-day task to follow up (targeting 2026-09-20).
- I'll drop the demo recording + a short one-pager into the Drive link so Claire has collateral while they triage roadmap asks.
- Recommend we offer a small courtesy: 2 hours of SRE/tech office-hours at no charge when they re-engage (reduces re-onboarding friction). Want to run that by Sales Ops for approval, but thought it's reasonable.

-Jordan

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.example.com>

Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.example.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo scheduling — NimbleHealth LLM pilot

Claire — following up to confirm we've put the pilot on hold as requested.

Summary of what we did on our side:
- Demo window removed from your calendar; invites cancelled.
- Deal NH-2026-0920 status set to Parked in HubSpot with reason: "customer roadmap reprioritization (regulatory initiatives)".
- Uploaded materials: 10-min demo recording, one-pager executive summary, and the roadmap snapshot you shared (links below).
- Tentative follow-up: we'll reach out week of 2026-09-20 to check status unless you contact us earlier.
- Offer: when you re-engage we'll allocate two hours of technical office-hours to help with re-onboarding (no charge).

Links/attachments:
- Demo recording: https://drive.google.com/file/d/demo_nimble_10min
- Exec one-pager: https://drive.google.com/file/d/nimble_exec_onepager
- Your roadmap snapshot: NimbleHealth_Q3_Roadmap_Snapshot.pdf (attached)

If you'd prefer a different follow-up cadence or want us to keep a soft placeholder on the calendar for September, say the word and we'll adjust. Otherwise, we'll wait to hear back from you.

Appreciate the transparency, and we'll be ready when NimbleHealth is.

Best regards,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.example.com
